summary_1line: Vyasa’s son Suka is miraculously born, revered by gods, masters sacred knowledge, and seeks the path of emancipation under guidance from his father and King Janaka.

image_candidates.scene_text: From the fire-sticks of Vyasa, the radiant child Suka emerges blazing like smokeless fire while gods, Gandharvas, and Apsaras celebrate in the sky.
The river-goddess Ganga appears in embodied form upon Mount Meru and bathes the newborn sage Suka as celestial flowers fall from the heavens.
Young ascetic Suka, serene and luminous, stands surrounded by swans, cranes, and parrots while gods and rishis gather to witness his birth.
